text: On it: I've asked all seven TAs for their availability next week and checked with the department office for fixed commitments. I'll book the staff meeting once the replies are in.

From the web app you can chat with me, send files, see the screen and use voice. I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, plus Messenger and Instagram — each needs a separate account with its own phone number that you create in the app and log me into by scanning a QR code. I can also make my own accounts on websites (e-mail and others), keeping passwords and one-time codes in my password store, ask for your help with a captcha or phone check, schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two things to settle: what should I be called from now on, and how should I be referred to — male, female or neutral forms? And what would you like to start with?
